title: Learning Canonical Register Automata over Ordered Data Domains
abstract: arXiv:2608.18765v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Register automata are finite automata equipped with memory that recognize data languages over infinite alphabets. In this work, we investigate active learning algorithms for deterministic register automata (DRAs) over ordered data domains--covering both dense domains, such as the rationals, and non-dense domains such as the integers. We show that the active learning problem for DRAs over both dense and non-dense ordered domains can be treated within a single unified framework. More specifically, we develop and implement a polynomial-time active learning procedure for DRAs over ordered domains, using oracles for membership, equivalence and memorability queries. The memorability queries were originally introduced for learning DRAs over domains with identity tests. translated_title: 有序数据域上规范寄存器自动机的学习
translated_abstract: 寄存器自动机是配备内存的有限自动机，能够识别无限字母表上的数据语言。在本工作中，我们研究了有序数据域上确定性寄存器自动机（DRAs）的主动学习算法——涵盖稠密域（如有理数）和非稠密域（如整数）。我们表明，在稠密和非稠密有序域上的DRAs主动学习问题可以在一个统一框架内处理。具体而言，我们开发并实现了一种多项式时间的主动学习过程，用于有序域上的DRAs，利用成员查询、等价查询和可记忆性查询的预言机。可记忆性查询最初是为学习具有身份测试的域上的DRAs而引入的。我们的统一框架还带来了一个新结果：非稠密有序整数域上DRAs的最小化是可判定的，这扩展了先前仅针对其他域已知的结果。
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一框架，用于在稠密和非稠密有序数据域上高效学习确定性寄存器自动机，并证明了整数域上DRAs最小化的可判定性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a unified framework for efficiently learning deterministic register automata over dense and non-dense ordered data domains, and establishes the decidability of DRA minimization over the integer domain.
